basic_info.description: Welcome to 531 Bowdoin Street, a spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in San Francisco's vibrant Portola neighborhood. This property combines classic charm with functional updates, including a well-designed addition behind the garage, featuring an extra 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, ideal for guests or additional living space. Please refer to the floor plans for more details on this unique layout. The upper main house offers a bright and open layout that extends to a stunning rear deck, providing sweeping city views. Downstairs, a lush backyard invites you to relax or entertain in privacy. With its convenient 1-car garage, this home offers both style and flexibility in a commuter-friendly neighborhood. Located near key transit routes and freeway access, Portola provides easy commuting  options for those traveling downtown, to the Peninsula, or beyond.
